what_this_commits: The V2 planted-correlation control arm for EXP-HQC-982268 (TASK-20260806-047535): design.md (pre-registered closed-form marginal law plus the boundary-template derivation/verification against the real decode_blocks, written before any data was generated), planted_arm_v2.py (imports stage_a.py's decode_blocks and measure.py's estimator/jackknife code directly, sha256-pinned), planted_results.json, comparison_report.md, run_manifest.yaml, and run logs.
ordering: Committed and verified BEFORE either independent review task (TASK-20260806-01a340 validator, TASK-20260806-ae74c4 red-team) is dispatched.
status_of_contents: OBSERVATIONS ONLY, per the executor's role. T = 1,000,000 trials (reduced 10x from PS-R3/V1's T=1e7, disclosed in design.md before the run: the real WHT decoder measures ~1,198 trials/core-second versus V1's hand-rolled ~64,700 trials/core-second). 434.3 of 1800 authorized core-seconds used (24%). All 17 tested cells (k = 2..18) report MATCH between the recovered log2_A_k and its closed-form planted value within the pipeline's own jackknife-SE interval. Both near-boundary templates' true decode (verified via both decode_blocks and an independent brute_force_decode/rm17_codewords exhaustive search) matched their intended fail/succeed label at every check, with no disagreement observed. The executor additionally demonstrated non-zero boundary-shift sensitivity directly: under a 'read one index early' perturbation (the literal shape of the V1/V3 defect classes that defeated the prior arm), both templates' decoded F flips in at least one tested scenario -- a property the Red Team proved was analytically impossible under the V1 arm's homogeneous-block construction. No interpretation of what this implies for OPEN-6 or EV-HQC-db1fd9 is offered here -- that is reserved for the Validator and Red Team.
claim_boundary: Toy. One planted instance, one run (plus two explicitly-disclosed scratch-space test invocations: a smoke test and a fail-closed deliberate-mismatch dry run, both distinguished from the authorized run in run_manifest.yaml and comparison_report.md), one seed family, no replication. This is an instrument check, not a measurement of HQC: no statement about A17, HQC's decoding-failure rate, or any standardized parameter set. Whether this arm closes, partially closes, or leaves open OPEN-6 is not decided by this snapshot and is the explicit deliverable of both pending reviews.
